pairs.registryProposal: structural-slot-validation-on-submit requires membership in a regenerated grid and calls a describing predicate a drift risk, while the golden path names the five-clause structural conjunction as the check. This repo deliberately validates by predicate, sharing TIMES and zonedInstant with the generator, so that a slot loaded just before midnight survives the rollover of the proposal window. The technique could say whether a predicate built from the generator's own constants and rules, with a stated rollover slack, counts as membership.
